unify_header.title: SVP Engineering, Agentic AI Platforms
unify_header.role_narrative: Led the platform roadmap, core systems architecture, and commercialization of a production-grade generative AI Solution Accelerator within a consulting firm, serving Fortune 500 financial institutions and converting bespoke client delivery into reusable IP deployed across enterprise lines of business.

companion_unify_bullets_context.text:
- bul_unify_001: Architected a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows, unifying deterministic routing, GraphRAG grounding, and runtime proof-bundle lineage across the agentic platform.
- bul_unify_002: Drove CFO-aligned enterprise adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization, aligning generative-AI workflows to finance-grade value criteria.
- bul_unify_003: Built evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls delivering audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows.
- bul_unify_004: Standardized the production adoption lifecycle, compressing the AI systems lifecycle from six months to three weeks through deterministic, auditable intake-to-monitoring stages.
- bul_unify_005: Architected distributed cloud and data execution infrastructure spanning Databricks Lakehouse, vector services, and API gateways to deliver cloud data and runtime integration patterns.
- bul_unify_006: Converted bespoke client delivery into reusable platform IP while scaling the engineering team from 8 to 28 to support platform commercialization.
